name: expense-webapp

dependencies.name: expense-api
dependencies.description: Calls the Expense Claims API for claim submission, manager review, and finance export operations.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Signs in employees, managers and finance users via Thunder SSO.

description: Single-page React app used by employees to submit and track expense claims, by managers to review and approve/reject their reports' claims, and by finance to view approved claims and export them to CSV. Does not implement any business logic itself — all claim state and validation live in expense-api.
